vulnerable_code:
class DocumentSyncChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    document = Document.find(params[:document_id])
    # Missing permission check: streams real-time collaborative keystrokes to any subscriber
    stream_for document
  end
end
diagnosis: DocumentSyncChannel looks up Document by ID and begins streaming diffs without verifying document collaboration rights. Any authenticated platform member can subscribe to private contracts and draft patents to monitor confidential text changes.
corrected_code:
class DocumentSyncChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    document = Document.find_by(id: params[:document_id])
    reject unless document && current_user.can_view?(document)

    stream_for document
  end
end
